Adjudicate the untrusted source review against ONLY the supplied authoritative TEXT and attached images. No tools, files, web, engineer decisions or history. Do not correct TEXT from raster.
Preserve original object, source, modality and scope. Evidence of another proposition cannot refute the original. Separate annotation conflict, physical defect, cause and conditional risk. Preserve supported defect cores even if other clauses fail. Check cited regions against the actual image, not merely coordinates. Recompute arithmetic with equal quantities and operating modes on both sides; identify rounded versus derived coefficients. Do not enlarge a recommendation beyond a supported discrepancy without explaining the need.
Return ONE JSON object: response_sha256 (copy required_response_sha256), origin="explicit_source_review", reviewer="candidate_adjudicator", reason, action (retain/revise/suppress/defer/question), claim_reviews.
claim_reviews covers every claim_id exactly once, each with claim_id, role (defect_basis/context/recommendation), verdict (supported/refuted/needs_data/not_checked), reason, same_scope_verified and evidence_sufficiency_verified booleans. Supported/refuted require sufficient same-proposition evidence. Do not relabel a supported defect as context to suppress it. If a supported context/recommendation has no direct evidence in the source review, provide supporting_claim_ids listing directly evidenced, supported claims and explain the inference. No circular or indirect chains. A defect_basis or refuted claim requires its own direct evidence; otherwise keep needs_data/not_checked.
Suppress only if every defect_basis is refuted. Retain only if every original substantive assertion is supported. Revise to preserve supported cores while qualifying unsupported statements; approved_fields must be an OBJECT with exactly problem,description,solution (nonempty Russian strings), and final_wording_verified must be a separate TOP-LEVEL boolean, never inside approved_fields. Defer only if no supported core exists. Question requires context_search_completed and engineer_action_required; with a supported core it instead requires question_basis minor_confirmed/outside_profile and profile_reason. Missing bounded context is an internal retrieval task, not an engineer question.
For retain/revise/question provide display_field_reviews as an OBJECT keyed by every supplied display_fields key, with {original_value_sha256:copy corresponding hash, value:string, consistent_with_final_claim:boolean, reason:string}. Review risk, consequence, severity and normative wording against the final text. A conditional risk is not disproved by lack of a recorded accident. An unverified standard remains unverified; do not invent applicability. Severity needs positive rationale, not just absence of contrary evidence. Retain cannot change any display field. An empty severity is invalid. A model decision is only a candidate, not automatic semantic acceptance.
